description: This file defines an enumeration 'ConnectionType' representing various connection types such as AMQP, MQTT, Kafka, and HTTP, within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for retrieving the connection type by name, checking header support, and implements CharSequence for string-like behavior.

classes.name: ConnectionType
classes.description: Enumeration of connection types including AMQP, MQTT, Kafka, and HTTP, with utility methods for type retrieval and property checks.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name associated with the connection type.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an Optional containing the ConnectionType matching the given name.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Implements CharSequence; returns the length of the name string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Implements CharSequence; returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Implements CharSequence; returns a subsequence of the name string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the connection type.
